label: Diagram 3.12
caption: Diagram 3.12 Example of wheelchair adaptable WC/cloakroom layout with potential to be wheelchair accessible
description:
This drawing is a plan view (top-down) showing two rectangular room layouts side by side, each with a door at the bottom drawn as an outward-opening arc.

Left, labelled "Example 3.12A – Wheelchair adaptable WC cloakroom": the room is dimensioned 1650mm wide along the top and 2200mm high on the left, with a 450mm segment marked at the top right. Inside are a basin symbol at the upper left, a WC symbol at the upper right, a grey shaded rectangular fixture, and a small dot at the top left corner. Dashed lines and arrows trace a turning/access zone around the interior.

Right, labelled "Example 3.12B – Wheelchair accessible WC cloakroom": the top is dimensioned 1650mm, with 1000mm and 450mm marked beneath it; the side shows 2200mm and 1000mm. Inside are a WC at the upper right, a grey shaded rectangle on the left side, a basin on the right wall, a shower-head symbol at the upper left with dashed spray lines, and a dashed access zone.

Below the plans, "Notes:" lists three numbered points concerning dimensions, door opening, and stack/drainage positions.
